usage: Usually refers to the act of cutting back branches on a plant or tree; in everyday Cantonese, it is a gardening/maintenance term.
It is a set phrase: 剪 + 枝. You can use it when talking about trees, shrubs, or potted plants.
Common in garden work, home plant care, and landscaping. It sounds practical and neutral, not formal.
For learners, remember that the word focuses on trimming branches, not cutting the whole plant or leaves.
